gen-amatic-sc-gf-maven-pro: Scribbled, slightly wonky charm: Amatic SC draws toothpaste-squeezed lines, its terminals stopping well short of the stem. And the standout quality is that jump from hand-drawn to sans, softened by Maven Pro's welcoming c.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-michroma: Hand-lettered and a bit goofy, Amatic SC keeps every stroke, diagonal or upright, the same stout line. But where Amatic SC charms with casual pen strokes, Michroma, a sans-serif, gives each wide-set letter room to stand tall.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-miriam-libre: Miriam Libre draws its text in wire-thin strokes with a sturdy, cast-iron lowercase. Miriam Libre's generous s bends meet Amatic SC's quirky, rustic headings and keep the whole page approachable instead of messy.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Terminals that stop far from the stem give Amatic SC a casual, toothpaste-squeezed look, quirky and rustic. Mochiy Pop P One feels clean and friendly beside it, its wide spacing smoothing out the quirk.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-montserrat-alternates: Loose, sketchy and rustic: Amatic SC's lines look squeezed from a tube, with terminals stopping far from the stem. The standout is the quirky hand against Montserrat Alternates' contemporary sans-serif.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-montserrat-underline: Amatic SC draws casual, toothpaste-squeezed letters with terminals that stop far from the stem, rustic and a touch quirky. Montserrat Underline brings breathing counters and oversized lowercase, and that handmade-versus-measured gap is what sticks.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-mozilla-headline: Amatic SC pulls its strokes like solder through a nozzle, rustic and quirky. Mozilla Headline, a sans-serif with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, gives it an approachable partner.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-mozilla-text: Amatic SC brings the personality, a constant-width outline you could trace with a finger. Mozilla Text does the steady talking, its tall-bodied lowercase and flared terminals giving it real presence.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-nata-sans: A toothpaste-squeezed line with terminals stopping far from the stem gives Amatic SC its rustic, hand-lettered charm. Amatic SC earns its keep big and short; Nata Sans stays clean.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-nobile: Rustic and quirky, Amatic SC is built on a monoline stroke with casual, pen-drawn letters. And Nobile follows with tight lowercase-to-capital proportions and open letter mouths, anchoring the hand-drawn look.
